verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies a sprint concept: a changelog note says Loops respond to changes in 'cycles', and one hands-on user ran a sprint workflow in Linear but found it lacked granular configuration for points/sprints, so they relied on tags and other features. No first-party documentation describes planning or managing sprints. Missing for 10: documented sprint/cycle creation and planning, sprint scope and capacity or points management, sprint tracking and reporting (e.g. burndown, rollover), and independent corroboration of a full sprint workflow.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can plan and manage sprints for agile software development

citations.quote: They now respond to more workspace activity, including changes to initiatives, projects, and cycles.
Where Linear lacked granular configuration for their points/sprint workflow, they got most benefits using tags and other features.
